resolved_findings.resolution: Fixed-heading planar circles replace tangential-heading full circles; now distinct from arc-turn sweep-angle variants. New planar-path capability stays unverified; current position must already lie on supplied circle.
Main strokes explicitly -x/+x/-z/+z with front legal entry, separate continuous return curve, and no implicit preparation.
Raised transverse waves, low fore/aft oscillations and ring-opening cycle retain distinct entry-pose contracts; cannot silently prepare the pose.
Forward/reverse longitudinal velocity uses instantaneous body axis; left/right denote heading changes.
Dedicated zero-motion hold, stopped-entry precondition, no distance/yaw/amplitude/speed inputs, no implicit repositioning or resumed command.

manual_conclusions: No remaining synonym-only or speed/amplitude/duration-only ID padding found. Left/right and distinct control channels, target geometry or trajectory direction remain meaningful distinctions.
Twenty whole-body entries are acceptable design atoms only as one synchronized target contract, never sequential macros.
No display, eye, finger-shape, independent wrist or shoulder-elevation capability is assumed.
No sensing, planning, navigation or management API is hidden in these motion contracts.
